expectations.text: Creates requirements.md inside a docs/ folder named with today's date prefix and a kebab-case feature name (docs/2026-09-04-<feature>/)
requirements.md has numbered requirements (R1, R2...) each with a user story and numbered acceptance criteria
Acceptance criteria use EARS keywords in English (WHEN / IF-THEN / WHILE / WHERE / THE SYSTEM SHALL) with Spanish prose, and each states a single observable, testable behavior
expectations.evidence: 28/28 abren con keyword EARS en inglés, prosa en español. check_specs marca R1.16 y R3.2 como compuestos: R3.2 es una «y» dentro de la condición; R1.16 («mostrar el uso y terminar con código ≠ 0») es el mismo patrón que R2.14 de la línea base, calificado igual.

expectations.text: No acceptance criterion names a concrete implementation artifact (file path, filename, function call or library) — those belong in Supuestos or in design.md, unless the exact value is itself the requirement and the criterion says what depends on it. Checkable with evals/check_specs.py
The assistant stops after requirements.md and explicitly asks for approval before writing design.md — it does not produce both documents in one turn
expectations.evidence: Se detiene después de requirements.md y pide aprobación («¿Lo aprobás…?»).

expectations.text: design.md covers architecture, data flow, interfaces, data models, error handling and testing strategy, and traces back to requirement ids (e.g. R1.2), including a test-to-criterion mapping
expectations.evidence: design.md con todas las secciones, 28 ids referenciados y mapa test→criterio. Pidió el sí antes de agregar R1.16 en la revisión previa al diseño y lo commiteó aparte.

expectations.text: No application code, test files, or task list is written at any point
expectations.evidence: Solo docs/: 0 archivos de código, sin tasks.md.
